fiscal.notes: This edition's Fiscal Operations Update covers public DEBT (DMO), not FAAC allocations — differs from April/May/July editions. Total public debt ₦153.3tn (Sep 2025, +0.6% QoQ, +7.7% YoY); external debt US$48.5bn (₦71.5tn); domestic debt ₦81.8tn (53.4% of total vs 46.6% external); debt-to-GDP ~36%; 2026 fiscal deficit projected ₦25.3tn vs ₦13.5tn in 2025.
